signal: Casepoint named Paul Colangelo CEO (June 2026) and partnered with Proofpoint

email.body1:
Daniel, saw Casepoint just brought on Paul Colangelo as CEO and launched the Proofpoint partnership.

New leadership and a fresh integration usually mean more accounts worth chasing than the BD team can realistically touch before momentum fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Casepoint off your hiring and tech-stack moves, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your BD number
email.body2:
Daniel, quick follow-up for Casepoint.

With a new CEO setting expectations, most BD teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble. That is solvable before it bites.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Casepoint needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Daniel, last bit of proof for Casepoint.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Casepoint's reply rate likely compares to other legal-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Daniel, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling Casepoint's pipeline without adding BD headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. A leadership transition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your eDiscovery motion? I'll tailor it to Casepoint either way.
